resource.name: CrossFlow
resource.creator: Nablast
resource.description: Moves Premiere projects into editable Resolve projects and returns graded clips to Premiere. Preserves supported timeline structures and renders unsupported effects through Media Encoder. Requires Resolve Studio 20+; Premiere/Media Encoder 25+ are needed for automatic preparation and return. Windows 10+ and macOS 12+ on Intel or Apple Silicon. Paid one-time license; trial is limited to 10 clips per sequence.
